sections.content: Combine the pretérito indefinido with direct object pronouns to recount what people bought, prepared, gave and received. Use the pronoun before the conjugated verb and make it agree with the object.

items.spanish: Compramos el regalo y lo envolvimos.
items.english: We bought the gift and wrapped it.

items.spanish: Preparamos la sorpresa y la llevamos.
items.english: We prepared the surprise and took it.

items.spanish: Lucía recibió las flores y las guardó.
items.english: Lucía received the flowers and put them away.

items.spanish: Compraron los regalos y los dieron a Lucía.
items.english: They bought the gifts and gave them to Lucía.

sections.content: Choose the pronoun from the object being replaced: el *regalo* → lo, la tarjeta → la, los *regalos* → los, las *flores* → las.
